quarter.zh: 2026 财年第四季（6 月季度）

en: Revenue rose 372% to $8.97B at an 84.6% gross margin, and non-GAAP EPS of $39.25 beat the ~$34.6 consensus; data-center revenue roughly doubled from Q1 to $2.98B. The board added $14B to the buyback. The Q1 guide of $10.3–10.8B and $44–46 EPS was about in line, with margins of 83–85%. CFO Luis Visoso stressed new long-term deals with eight customers, covering over half of fiscal 2027 bits and about two-thirds of 2028, to make NAND less cyclical.

The stock had jumped 11% the day before and fell 5.4% on report day, then another 6.8% the next session, since the revenue guide sat slightly below consensus and margins looked to have peaked. It hit $1,212 on Aug 7, about 10% below the pre-report close. The Aug 13 investor day, which laid out the multi-year agreements, sent it up 13.7%, and it now trades well above the pre-report level.
zh: 营收增长 372% 至 89.7 亿美元，毛利率 84.6%，非 GAAP 每股收益 39.25 美元，高于约 34.6 美元的预期；数据中心营收较上季约翻倍至 29.8 亿美元。董事会追加 140 亿美元回购。第一季指引营收 103–108 亿美元、每股收益 44–46 美元，基本符合预期，毛利率 83–85%。CFO 路易斯·维索索强调与八家客户签订的长期协议，覆盖 2027 财年过半、2028 财年约三分之二的出货量，以降低 NAND 的周期性。
股价前一天大涨 11%，财报当天跌 5.4%，次日再跌 6.8%：营收指引略低于预期，且毛利率似已见顶。8 月 7 日低见 1,212 美元，较财报前收盘低约 10%。8 月 13 日投资者日详细介绍多年期协议，股价大涨 13.7%，目前明显高于财报前水平。

bio.en: Western Digital CEO from 2020, he led the separation of its flash business and became Sandisk's CEO at the February 2025 spin-off. Before that, nearly two decades at Cisco, latterly running its networking and security business.
bio.zh: 2020 年起任西部数据 CEO，主导闪存业务分拆，2025 年 2 月闪迪独立上市时出任 CEO。此前在思科工作近二十年，最后负责网络与安全业务。

bio.en: CFO since the 2025 spin-off. Previously CFO of Unity Software and of Palo Alto Networks, and earlier CFO of Amazon Web Services and Amazon's worldwide consumer business, after starting at Procter & Gamble.
bio.zh: 2025 年分拆起任 CFO。此前任 Unity Software 和 Palo Alto Networks 的 CFO，更早担任亚马逊 AWS 及全球消费者业务 CFO，职业生涯始于宝洁。
